note: Replicate outputs used for the pathkr landing redesign. frontend/public/landing holds the files the site serves; this folder keeps originals, cut-outs and rejected variants.

served.logo/*.svg: hand-built from Bricolage Grotesque 800 outlines, not generated

prompts.style_v2: glossy 3D clay render in the style of a toy, extremely vivid saturated flat colors, only pure red-orange #f42902, bright neon mint green #83fd80 and clean white #fdfdff, plain flat white background, soft contact shadow, absolutely no text, no letters, no words, centered, chunky rounded shapes
prompts.cv-sheet: a single tilted blank white paper document with a red-orange rounded header block, four plain gray rounded bars as lines, a small red-orange circle avatar at top left, and a large neon mint green rounded checkmark badge overlapping the lower corner, + style_v2
prompts.trophy: a chunky red-orange trophy cup with a white star and mint green base, + style_v2
prompts.magnifier: a chunky magnifying glass with a mint green lens rim and red-orange handle over a blank white paper, + style_v2
prompts.chart: a chunky 3D bar chart with three rising rounded bars in red-orange, white and neon mint green, with a small white star on the tallest bar, + style_v2
prompts.shield: a chunky white shield with a big neon mint green checkmark and a red-orange rim, + style_v2
prompts.briefcase: a chunky red-orange briefcase with a white handle and a mint green clasp, + style_v2
prompts.rejected_v1: first pass used a softer style prompt (soft glossy 3D clay render, pale mint background); output came out pastel and the resume sheet carried the word Resume
prompts.bolt: a chunky lightning bolt in neon mint green with a red-orange outline puff; rejected, washed-out colours
prompts.cloud-upload: a chunky white 3D cloud with a thick red-orange upward arrow rising out of it and a small neon mint document peeking from behind, + style_v2
prompts.scanner: a chunky white paper sheet passing through a red-orange scanner bar with a mint green glowing scan line across it, + style_v2
prompts.pencil: a chunky red-orange pencil with a white tip drawing a wavy neon mint line, with two small white sparkle stars, + style_v2
prompts.pdf-export: a chunky white document with a folded corner, a red-orange corner tab, and a thick neon mint downward arrow badge at the bottom, + style_v2

known_issues: Mint in the renders reads pastel next to #83fd80; flatten in CSS or regenerate
shield cut-out is semi-transparent glass, use on red or ink grounds
note_process: cloud-upload, scanner, pencil and pdf-export were generated 2026-11-08 for the process section; background removal ran on the base64 of the flux output
